profile.name: Alex Rivera
profile.title: Senior Backend Engineer
profile.tagline: Backend systems that stay boring under load

data.summary: Backend engineer with six years building and operating API services for small teams, most recently focused on payment reliability and on-call sanity.

jobs.description: Payment processing platform for small merchants.

highlights.summary: Rebuilt the payment-retry path so duplicate submissions could no longer double-charge a merchant
specifics: Designed an idempotency-key table with a unique constraint enforced at the database
Migrated the existing retry queue over a weekend with no downtime
highlights.story: A merchant lost a day's revenue to a double-charge bug the week before I joined; fixing the class of bug, not the instance, was the first thing I asked to own.

jobs.description: Route-planning software for regional delivery fleets.

highlights.summary: Cut route-recalculation latency by adding a bounded cache in front of the routing service
specifics: Profiled the recalculation path and found 80% of requests repeated within a five-minute window
Added a size-bounded LRU cache with a correctness fallback on miss

metrics.basis: internal load test, matched to production traffic shape

personal_projects.name: example-webhook-relay
personal_projects.description: A small open-source relay for replaying webhooks during local development.

narrative.career_arc: Started in general backend work, narrowed toward systems where correctness under retry and failure matters more than feature velocity.
narrative.current_status: Looking for the next role after two years stabilizing a payments platform.
narrative.motivation: Prefers small teams where one engineer can own a system end to end.
narrative.looking_for: Backend or platform roles with real operational ownership.
narrative.avoiding: Pure feature-factory roles with no on-call ownership.
narrative.working_style: Writes the failure mode down before writing the happy path.
narrative.strengths: Debugging distributed failures under time pressure.
narrative.voice: Direct, understated, prefers specifics over adjectives.

logistics.salary_expectation: Market rate for senior backend, negotiable
logistics.relocation: Not relocating; open to hybrid in Austin
logistics.on_site: Up to two days a week
